title: Global shell responsive & accessibility
scope: Navbar utility bar and main navigation
Footer navigation, contact, ecosystem and legal links
shell-level focus and transient navigation state

resolvedFindings.change: Emergency 911, City Hall, All hotlines and Official Makati site controls now expose a 44px minimum interaction height.
Footer contact, social, GitHub, section navigation, ecosystem and legal links now expose a 44px minimum interaction height.
BetterBarangay selector and homepage action now expose a 44px minimum interaction height.
Desktop submenu chevron controls now have both 44px minimum height and width.
BrandMark home link now keeps a 44px minimum interaction height even when the narrow-screen horizontal logo image is shorter.
Navbar and BetterBarangay transparent select overlays now trigger a visible focus-within ring on the styled proxy surface.
Dark utility, BetterBarangay, inverse-brand and Footer links explicitly use the gold secondary focus outline.
Open mobile/desktop navigation state is cleared whenever pathname, search or hash changes.
BetterBarangay uses the shorter visible 'Homepage' label below the sm breakpoint while preserving a descriptive aria-label.

preservedStrengths: Skip link and primary main landmark remain in App.
Desktop/mobile navigation split remains at xl.
Desktop and mobile submenu controls retain aria-expanded and aria-controls.
Escape still closes menus and returns focus to the relevant control.
Mobile search, barangay and menu controls remain 44px square.
Footer remains an implicit contentinfo landmark.

sticky header behavior with browser zoom
